market_name: Will 3 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market's implied cut count actually moved and in which direction; confirm no coincident FOMC/CPI headline already explains it.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT and 2y/10y yield move to see if bonds are tracking the implied dovish/hawkish shift.
time_plan.2h: Re-check fed funds futures (implied 2026 path) for confirmation the repricing is broad, not idiosyncratic to Polymarket.
time_plan.6h: Assess whether move persisted or mean-reverted; look for official Fed communication that may have driven it.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate net TLT return vs prediction and whether the prediction-market lead was informative or noise.

predictions.reasoning: This market prices the number of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026. A sharp rise in the implied probability of 3+ cuts signals a more dovish rate path, which pushes the expected policy rate lower and lifts long-duration Treasury prices (yields fall). TLT is the most direct liquid proxy for the front-to-long end reaction to Fed easing expectations. If instead the probability fell (hawkish), the sign flips. Magnitude over 12h is modest because a single Polymarket probability shift is a weak, noisy sensor relative to Treasury market depth already discounting Fed guidance.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm the implied-cut probability moved dovish and check DXY reaction for corroboration.
time_plan.1h: Compare gold move to real-yield (TIPS) move to verify the rate channel is active.
time_plan.2h: Check whether gold move is driven by the rate story or a separate risk/geopolitical catalyst.
time_plan.6h: Assess persistence and whether dollar weakness accompanied the gold move.
time_plan.12h: Score realized GLD return against prediction and note whether the prediction market led spot gold.

predictions.reasoning: A dovish shift toward more 2026 cuts lowers real yields and typically weakens the dollar, both supportive for gold. GLD is a liquid proxy. The link is real but second-order and diluted by many other gold drivers (geopolitics, inflation surprises), so confidence and magnitude are modest and the 12h move is very unlikely to reach the 700bp tradable threshold.

evidence_used: Market question tracks count of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026, a direct read on the expected policy path
Rate-path expectations transmit mechanically to Treasury yields, the dollar, and gold
Liquid ETF proxies (TLT, GLD) capture duration and real-rate/dollar channels
uncertainty_notes: The market prompt does not specify the direction of the probability move; predictions assume a dovish (more-cuts) shift and reverse if hawkish
Treasury and gold markets are deep and likely already price most Fed guidance, limiting incremental information from a Polymarket move
12h window is short for a slow-moving macro theme spanning all of 2026

llm_justification.summary: This market is a direct gauge of the 2026 Fed easing path. A sharp rise in the implied probability of 3+ cuts is a dovish signal that should lift long-duration Treasuries (TLT) and, via lower real yields and a softer dollar, support gold (GLD). Both mappings are directionally sound but the effect is second-order and diluted by deeper, faster markets, so expected 12h magnitudes are small (tens of bps), well below the 700bp tradable threshold. Treat the prediction market as a noisy sensor, not confirmation.
key_assumptions: The observed probability shift is dovish (toward more cuts); sign flips if hawkish
No simultaneous dominant catalyst (CPI, NFP, FOMC, geopolitical shock) overrides the rate channel
TLT and GLD remain liquid and their historical sensitivity to Fed-path repricing holds
failure_modes: The move was already public (post-FOMC/CPI) and fully priced into bonds and gold, so no follow-through
Direction misread: a rise in this specific '3 cuts' strike could reflect fewer total cuts if higher strikes fall, complicating the dovish interpretation
Weak proxy exposure: gold is driven by many non-rate factors and may not track the signal
Mean reversion: thin prediction-market liquidity produces a spurious spike that reverses within hours
Magnitude shortfall: even if directionally right, moves stay far below the 700bp tradable bar
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
